email.subject: Quick note on the Anchor Works site
email.body:
Hi Nora,

I took a look at Anchor Works Fitness's site. Two things are likely costing you members: there's no way to book a class or session online, so anyone checking at night or between errands has to call and wait or just moves on to a gym where they can book instantly. Also, your hours aren't listed anywhere, so people can't even tell if you're open before showing up or calling.

I fix stuff like this for a flat fee, no retainer. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough and show you exactly what I'd change, no pressure either way.

Worth a quick call this week?

Alex
